beats.narration: He killed his entire family in one night
beats.caption: He killed his entire family in one night.

beats.action: stands still at the end of the empty street, back to us, blade lowered

beats.camera_move: crane down from the red moon to street level
beats.lighting: cold blue moonlight + a red moon rim; paper lanterns warm
beats.fg: a fallen paper lantern still burning

beats.caption: He killed his entire family in one night. / Then he spent years making / his little brother hate him, on purpose.
beats.action: kneeling in the street, looking up, tears; hands in fists

beats.narration: hate him on purpose
beats.caption: his little brother hate him, on purpose.
beats.action: turns his head; red eyes ignite looking down

beats.caption: his little brother hate him, on purpose. / Itachi Uchiha was a ninja, / in a world where hidden villages train children

beats.action: ninja leap across rooftops (small silhouettes)
beats.camera_move: establishing drift + crane down over the gate

beats.caption: in a world where hidden villages train children / to fight and spy.

beats.action: throw practice knives; one hits the post

beats.purpose: children trained to fight and spy

beats.caption: to fight and spy. / His clan, the Uchiha, / ran the village police and were born

beats.action: stand guard, one checks a paper

beats.narration: were born with a rare power in their eyes
beats.caption: ran the village police and were born / with a rare power in their eyes.
beats.world_visual: an eye turns red: the clan's power
beats.action: eye opens; the iris floods red

beats.narration: But after a monster attacked the village
beats.caption: with a rare power in their eyes. / But after a monster attacked the village,
beats.world_visual: the village burning at night under a vast shadow
beats.action: rooftops burn; a giant shadow passes over the cliffs

beats.narration: the leaders suspected the Uchiha
beats.caption: the leaders suspected the Uchiha.
beats.world_visual: council table: a file on the clan with a red mark
beats.action: one slides a file across the table and taps it
beats.camera_move: slow push to the file (object insert)

beats.narration: Pushed aside the clan began planning a coup
beats.caption: Pushed aside, the clan began planning a coup.
beats.world_visual: clan meeting at night around a map of the village
beats.character: clan men around a low table
beats.action: fingers trace a route on the map; one stabs a knife into it

beats.narration: Itachi had one person he loved more than anything
beats.caption: Pushed aside, the clan began planning a coup. / Itachi had one person / he loved more than anything:
beats.action: sits on the porch, looks up and smiles

beats.narration: his little brother Sasuke
beats.caption: he loved more than anything: / his little brother, Sasuke.
beats.action: Sasuke runs in and jumps on his back; both laugh

beats.narration: Whenever Sasuke begged him to train Itachi would
beats.caption: his little brother, Sasuke. / Whenever Sasuke begged him to train, / Itachi would poke his forehead and promise.
beats.action: Sasuke tugs his sleeve, pleading with open hands

beats.narration: poke his forehead and promise
beats.caption: Itachi would poke his forehead and promise.
beats.action: two fingers tap Sasuke's forehead; Sasuke flinches, rubs it

beats.narration: Next time
beats.caption: Next time.
beats.action: Itachi smiles over his shoulder

beats.narration: The village made Itachi a spy inside his own clan
beats.caption: Next time. / The village made Itachi / a spy inside his own clan.
beats.action: crouches, watches the clan meeting through a roof gap
beats.environment: rooftops of the clan district at night
beats.lighting: cold blue moonlight + a red moon rim; paper lanterns warm

beats.narration: Then the elders ordered him to stop the coup by wiping out the Uchiha
beats.caption: Then the elders ordered him / to stop the coup by wiping / out the Uchiha.
beats.action: an elder slides a sealed scroll to him; he does not take it at once (hesitation)

beats.narration: A civil war would have killed thousands
beats.caption: A civil war would have killed thousands.
beats.action: stands at the cliff edge looking at the village lights
beats.environment: cliff top over the village at night
beats.camera_move: dolly out to reveal the whole village

beats.narration: So at thirteen Itachi chose the village over his family
beats.caption: A civil war would have killed thousands. / So at thirteen, / Itachi chose the village over his family.
beats.action: a tear forms; he closes his eyes; ties the headband tighter

beats.narration: He killed them all
beats.caption: Itachi chose the village over his family. / He killed them all.
beats.action: lanterns go out one by one down the street

beats.narration: Except one
beats.caption: He killed them all. / Except one.
beats.action: slides a door open, stands in the warm light, looking out
beats.lighting: warm doorway light vs blue night

beats.narration: He couldn't kill Sasuke
beats.caption: He couldn't kill Sasuke.
beats.action: blade lowers; his hand trembles

beats.narration: So he made sure Sasuke would hate him instead
beats.caption: So he made sure / Sasuke would hate him instead.
beats.action: Itachi's face goes cold, red eyes; Sasuke backs away, terrified

beats.narration: Hate would make him strong
beats.caption: Sasuke would hate him instead. / Hate would make him strong.
beats.action: punches a wooden post in the rain until it cracks

beats.narration: One day Sasuke would kill the traitor and be called a hero
beats.caption: One day Sasuke would kill the traitor / and be called a hero.
beats.action: a wanted poster of Itachi marked TRAITOR flaps on a board in the rain

beats.narration: That explains the massacre It doesn't make it right
beats.caption: and be called a hero. / That explains the massacre. / It doesn't make it right.
beats.action: the empty clan street years later; a child's wooden practice knife in the dust

beats.narration: Years later Sasuke caught him
beats.caption: Years later, Sasuke caught him.
beats.action: face each other across a ruined stone hall

beats.narration: Sick and dying Itachi reached out one last time
beats.caption: Years later, Sasuke caught him. / Sick and dying, / Itachi reached out one last time

beats.narration: and poked his forehead
beats.caption: and poked his forehead.
beats.action: two fingers touch Sasuke's forehead — same framing as beat 14; Itachi smiles

beats.narration: There would be no next time
beats.caption: There would be no next time.

beats.narration: Only after Itachi died did Sasuke learn the truth
beats.caption: Only after Itachi died / did Sasuke learn the truth.
beats.action: sits at the cliff edge over the village; hand rises to his forehead
beats.environment: cliff over the village at night

beats.narration: Every lie had been meant to keep
beats.caption: Every lie had been meant / to keep him alive.
beats.action: fingers on his forehead where Itachi touched; tears

beats.narration: him alive
beats.caption: to keep him alive.
beats.action: memory: the porch at sunset, Itachi pokes his forehead, both laugh
